title: tracy-host: an imported site already bound to a quickstart contract is marked contract-derived and no longer reported as a derive failure at every start; any other refusal still fails and is retried
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-host/test/content-identity.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of the cases named in run.tests.
expect: A WordPress plugin answering conflict "This site is bound to a quickstart contract; derive refuses to replace it" leaves contract-derived.done and logs no "content contract not derived" line.
A Joomla derive script printing TRACY_RESULT derived=kept leaves contract-derived.done and logs no failure.
Any other refusal, including conflict "This site is not bound to a quickstart contract", is warned, writes no marker and is asked again at the next start.
evidence: 16/11/2026 dev host: an imported Joomla customer site logged "content contract not derived — the script reported derived=failed; tried again at the next start" at every tracy-host start. Running joomla-content-derive.php in its web container printed "!! derive: refused: conflict This site is bound to a quickstart contract; derive refuses to replace it" and TRACY_RESULT derived=failed.
fence: Unit cases with a fake run and fetch; the live Cowork component is not called.

tests: a WordPress site already bound to a quickstart contract keeps it: marked, said once, no failure
a Joomla site whose script says derived=kept is marked and not reported as a failure
any other refusal to derive stays a failure: warned, not marked, asked again next start
judgeDerive reads the plugin the way this pass does
